title.zh: 卷四十三 志第十九 地理四
title.raw: 卷四十三 志第十九 地理四 Volume 43 Treatises 19: Geography 4

translations.literal: Treatise Nineteen, Geography Four.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Nineteen: Geography, Part Four.

translations.literal: ○ Sichuan Jiangxi
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Sichuan and Jiangxi

sentences.zh: 四川《禹貢》樑、荊二州之域。

translations.literal: Sichuan, in the Tribute of Yu, was the domain of the Liang and Jing two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan fell within the Liang and Jing provinces described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 元置四川等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Yuan established the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Seat at Chengdu Route.
translations.idiomatic: Its seat was at Chengdu Route.

sentences.zh: 又置羅羅蒙慶等處宣慰司，治建昌路。

translations.literal: Also established the Luoluo-Mengqing Pacification Commission, seat at Jianchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: It also set up the Luoluo-Mengqing Pacification Commission, seated at Jianchang Route.

translations.literal: Subordinate to Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: This office was subordinate to the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Hongwu year four sixth month pacified Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Hongwu 4 the region was pacified with the surrender of Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 七月置四川等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Seventh month established Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was established.

translations.literal: Ninth month established Chengdu Regional Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Chengdu Regional Guard was founded.

translations.literal: Together with the Branch Secretariat same administration.
translations.idiomatic: It shared the same seat and administration as the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八年十月改都衛爲四川都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Year eight tenth month changed Regional Guard to Sichuan Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 8 the regional guard became the Sichuan Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 領招討司一，宣慰司二，安撫司五，長官司二十二及諸衛所。

translations.literal: Oversaw one pacification superintendency, two pacification commissions, five soothing commissions, twenty-two native chieftain offices, and various guards and battalions.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw one pacification superintendency, two pacification commissions, five soothing commissions, twenty-two native chieftain offices, and the various guards and battalions.

sentences.zh: 九年六月改行中書省爲承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: Year nine sixth month changed Branch Secretariat to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9 the branch secretariat was made a provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 領府十三，直隸州六，宣撫司一，安撫司一，屬州十五，縣百十一，長官司十六。

translations.literal: Thirteen prefectures, six directly governed zhou, one pacification commissionerate, one soothing commission, fifteen subordinate zhou, one hundred eleven counties, sixteen native chieftain offices.
translations.idiomatic: It had thirteen prefectures, six directly governed zhou, one pacification commissionerate, one soothing commission, fifteen subordinate zhou, 111 counties, and sixteen native chieftain offices.

translations.literal: As li, one thousand one hundred fifty-odd.
translations.idiomatic: Its registered area was more than 1,150 li square.

translations.literal: North to Guangyuan, borders Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Northward to Guangyuan, on the Shaanxi frontier.

translations.literal: East to Wushan, borders Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to Wushan, bordering Huguang.

sentences.zh: 南至烏撒、東川，與貴州、雲南界。

translations.literal: South to Wusa, Dongchuan, borders Guizhou, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Southward to Wusa and Dongchuan, on the Guizhou and Yunnan frontiers.

translations.literal: West to Weimao, borders Xifan.
translations.idiomatic: Westward to Weimao, bordering the Xifan frontier.

sentences.zh: 距南京七千二百六十里，京師一萬七百一十里。

translations.literal: Distance from Nanjing seven thousand two hundred sixty li, from capital ten thousand seven hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 7,260 li from Nanjing and 10,710 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年編戶二十一萬五千七百一十九，口一百四十六萬六千七百七十八。

translations.literal: Hongwu twenty-six registered households two hundred fifteen thousand seven hundred nineteen, mouths one million four hundred sixty-six thousand seven hundred seventy-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 registered households totaled 215,719 and population 1,466,778.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年，戶二十五萬三千八百三，口二百五十九萬八千四百六十。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year four, households two hundred fifty-three thousand eight hundred three, mouths two million five hundred ninety-eight thousand four hundred sixty.
translations.idiomatic: By Hongzhi 4 there were 253,803 households and 2,598,460 people.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，戶二十六萬二千六百九十四，口三百一十萬二千七十三。

translations.literal: Wanli year six, households two hundred sixty-two thousand six hundred ninety-four, mouths three million one hundred two thousand seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 6 the province had 262,694 households and 3,102,073 people.

translations.literal: Chengdu Prefecture: Yuan Chengdu Route.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu Prefecture—under the Yuan it was Chengdu Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu year four made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 it was made a prefecture.

translations.literal: Governing six zhou, twenty-five counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed six zhou and twenty-five counties:

translations.literal: Chengdu, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu (seat-attached county).

translations.literal: Hongwu eleventh year built Shu princely mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 11 the Shu princely mansion was built here.

translations.literal: Huayang, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Huayang (seat-attached county).

translations.literal: North has Wudan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Wudan.

sentences.zh: 又有外江，自灌縣分流經城北，繞城而南，一名清遠江。

translations.literal: Also has Outer River, from Guan County diverges and passes city north, circles city and south, one name Qingyuan River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Outer River, which branches from Guan County, runs north of the city, and circles southward—also called the Qingyuan River.

sentences.zh: 又有內江，亦自灌縣分流經城南，繞城而東，亦名石犀渠。

translations.literal: Also has Inner River, also from Guan County diverges and passes city south, circles city and east, also named Shixi Canal.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Inner River, which likewise branches from Guan County, passes south of the city, and circles eastward—also called the Shixi Canal.

translations.literal: Conjoined flow south pours into Great River.
translations.idiomatic: Their combined current flows south into the Great River.

translations.literal: These are this prefecture city's Inner and Outer Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: These are the Inner and Outer Rivers of the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 東有寧州衛，洪武十一年四月置。

translations.literal: East has Ningzhou Guard, Hongwu eleventh year fourth month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Ningzhou Guard, established in the fourth month of Hongwu 11.

translations.literal: Southeast has Majunzhai Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Majunzhai Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Shuangliu, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Shuangliu county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入華陽縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished merged into Huayang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Huayang County.

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 13 it was restored.

sentences.zh: 東南有牧馬川，即府在內、外江下流也。

translations.literal: Southeast has Madao Stream, namely this prefecture's Inner and Outer Rivers lower course.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Madao Stream, the lower reach of the prefecture's Inner and Outer Rivers.

translations.literal: Pi, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Pi county lies west of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 有內江，一名郫江，即府城內江之上流也。

translations.literal: Has Inner River, one name Pi River, namely this prefecture city Inner River's upper course.
translations.idiomatic: It has the Inner River, also called the Pi River—the upper reach of the prefectural city's Inner River.

translations.literal: Wenjiang, prefecture west slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjiang county lies slightly southwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Southwest has Zao River, also called Inner River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Zao River, also called the Inner River.

translations.literal: Xinfan, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xinfan county lies northwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入成都縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished merged into Chengdu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Chengdu County.

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 13 it was restored.

translations.literal: Northwest has Tuo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Tuo River.

translations.literal: Also west has Jianmei outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Jianmei outlet.

translations.literal: Xindu, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Xindu county lies north of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 東有雒水，自什邡縣流經此，下流至瀘州入大江，亦曰中水。

translations.literal: East has Luo River, from Shifang County flows through here, lower course to Luzhou enters Great River, also called Middle Water.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Luo River, which flows from Shifang County through here and below reaches Luzhou before entering the Great River—also called the Middle Water.

sentences.zh: 北有湔水，即大江別流，自灌縣東北出，流經此，至漢州入雒水。

translations.literal: North has Jian River, namely Great River branch flow, from Guan County northeast issues, flows through here, to Hanzhou enters Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Jian River, a branch of the Great River that issues northeast from Guan County, passes through here, and at Hanzhou joins the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 東北有綿水，自漢州流至此入雒江。

translations.literal: Northeast has Mian River, from Hanzhou flows to here enters Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Mian River, which flows from Hanzhou and here joins the Luo River.

translations.literal: Three waters same flow, also called Pi River.
translations.idiomatic: The three streams run together and are also called the Pi River.

translations.literal: Peng, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Peng county lies north of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Yuan Peng zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Peng zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 北有九隴山，有葛王貴山，又有大隋山、中隋山。

translations.literal: North has Jiulong Mountain, has Ge Wanggui Mountain, also has Great Sui Mountain, Middle Sui Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north are Mt. Jiulong, Mt. Ge Wanggui, and also Mt. Great Sui and Mt. Middle Sui.

sentences.zh: 南有沱江，又北有濛水流合焉。

translations.literal: South has Tuo River, also north has Meng River flows and joins.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Tuo River; to the north the Meng River flows in and joins it.

sentences.zh: 又東有濛陽縣，元屬彭州。

translations.literal: Also east has Mengyang County, Yuan subordinate to Peng zhou.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was Mengyang County, which under the Yuan was subordinate to Peng zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in the fifth month of Hongwu 10.

translations.literal: Also north has Baishi Gully Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Baishi Gully Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Chongning, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning county lies northwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Yuan subordinate to Peng zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Peng zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu year four subordinate to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 it was placed under the prefecture.

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month abolished merged into Guan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10 it was abolished and merged into Guan County.

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 13 it was restored.

translations.literal: South has Tuo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Tuo River.

translations.literal: Guan, prefecture west slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Guan county lies slightly northwest of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Yuan Guan zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Guan zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu period, reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongwu reign it was reduced to a county.

translations.literal: Northwest has Guankou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Guankou.

sentences.zh: 又有玉壘山，下有玉壘關，一名七盤關。

translations.literal: Also has Yulei Mountain, below has Yulei Pass, one name Qipan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Mt. Yulei, below which is Yulei Pass, also called Qipan Pass.

translations.literal: Also southwest has Qingcheng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Qingcheng.

sentences.zh: 又西有湔江，亦曰都江，亦曰湔堋江，古離堆也。

translations.literal: Also west has Jian River, also called Du River, also called Jianpeng River, ancient Lidui.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Jian River, also called the Du River and the Jianpeng River—the ancient Lidui works.

sentences.zh: 岷江經此，正流引而南，支流分三道，繞成都境。

translations.literal: Min River passes here, main current drawn south, branch currents divide three channels, circle Chengdu territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Min River passes here; its main current is led south while branch streams split into three channels that circle the Chengdu region.

translations.literal: Has stone canal outlet.
translations.idiomatic: There is a stone canal outlet.

sentences.zh: 又有白沙水，下流入都江。

translations.literal: Also has Baisha Water, lower flow enters Du River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Baisha Stream, which below flows into the Du River.

sentences.zh: 又南有沱江，即郫江上源也。

translations.literal: Also south has Tuo River, namely Pi River upper source.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Tuo River, the upper source of the Pi River.

translations.literal: Also west has Canya Pass Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Canya Pass Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Southwest has Liaze Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Liaze Pass.

translations.literal: Jintang, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang county lies east of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入新都縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished merged into Xindu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Xindu County.

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 13 it was restored.

translations.literal: Northeast has Sanxue Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Mt. Sanxue.

translations.literal: South has Yunding Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Yunding.

sentences.zh: 有金堂峽，雒水經此，曰金堂河。

translations.literal: Has Jintang Gorge, Luo River passes here, called Jintang River.
translations.idiomatic: There is Jintang Gorge, through which the Luo River passes as the Jintang River.

translations.literal: Southeast also has Huaikou Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is also the Huaikou Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Renshou, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou county lies slightly southeast of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: East has Ligan Mountain, below has salt well.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Ligan, below which is a salt well.

sentences.zh: 東有三嵎山，又有蟠溪，下流入資江。

translations.literal: East has Sanyu Mountain, also has Pan Stream, lower flow enters Zi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are Mt. Sanyu and the Pan Stream, which below flows into the Zi River.

sentences.zh: 又南有陵井，產鹽，亦曰仙井。

translations.literal: Also south has Ling Well, produces salt, also called Immortal Well.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Ling Well, which yields salt and is also called the Immortal Well.

translations.literal: Jingyan, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyan county lies slightly southeast of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Hongwu sixth year twelfth month established.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in the twelfth month of Hongwu 6.

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month abolished merged into Renshou County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10 it was abolished and merged into Renshou County.

translations.literal: Thirteenth year eleventh month restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 13 it was restored.

translations.literal: Northeast has Tieshan, formerly produced iron.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Mt. Tie, which formerly yielded iron.

translations.literal: South has salt well.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is a salt well.

translations.literal: Zi, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Zi county lies east of the prefecture seat.

translations.literal: Ming Yuzhen established Ziz Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Yuzhen established Ziz Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, downgraded to county.
translations.idiomatic: In early Hongwu it was downgraded to a county.

sentences.zh: 南有珠江，即雒江也，東流爲資江。

translations.literal: South has Zhujiang River, that is Luo River, east flow becomes Zi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Zhujiang River—the Luo River—which flowing east becomes the Zi River.

translations.literal: East has Yinshan town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Yinshan town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Neijiang, Ziz Prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Neijiang lies southeast of Ziz Prefecture.

translations.literal: Hongwu period established.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in the Hongwu reign.

translations.literal: West has Zhongjiang River, that is Luo's different name.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Zhongjiang River, another name for the Luo.

translations.literal: South has Baimu town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Baimu town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: An, prefecture north slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: An County lies north slightly east of Ziz Prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan An Zhou, seat at northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was An Zhou; the seat lay in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，降爲縣，移於今治。

translations.literal: Hongwu period, downgraded to county, moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu reign it was downgraded to a county and moved to the present seat.

sentences.zh: 南有浮山，黑水出焉，南流入羅江縣界。

translations.literal: South has Fushan Mountain, Hei River issues there, south flows into Luojiang County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Fushan Mountain, from which the Hei River issues and flows south into Luojiang County.

translations.literal: North has Qushan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Qushan Pass.

translations.literal: East has Xiaodongba Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Xiaodongba Pass.

sentences.zh: 又東南有睢水關，關西有綿堰堡，綿水發源處也。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Sui River Pass; west of pass has Mianyan Fort, Mian River source place.
translations.idiomatic: Also to the southeast is Sui River Pass; west of the pass is Mianyan Fort, the source of the Mian River.

translations.literal: Jianzhou Hongwu year six downgraded to county.
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhou was downgraded to a county in Hongwu 6.

translations.literal: Zhengde year eight again elevated to zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 8 it was again elevated to a zhou.

translations.literal: Old seat at Jiang River north.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat lay north of the Jiang River.

translations.literal: Zhengde year eight moved seat to river south.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 8 the seat was moved south of the river.

translations.literal: Northeast has Shigu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Shigu Mountain.

translations.literal: West has Fendong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Fendong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有雁水，即雒水也，絳水自北來合焉，一名赤水，亦曰牛鞞水。

translations.literal: East has Yan River, that is Luo River; Jiang River from north comes to join, one name Chishui, also called Niupi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Yan River—the Luo River; the Jiang River comes from the north to join it, also called the Chishui River and the Niupi River.

translations.literal: Also within city wall has Niupi Well, produces salt.
translations.idiomatic: Also within the city wall is Niupi Well, which produces salt.

translations.literal: West has Longquan town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Longquan town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Southwest has Yang'an Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Yang'an Pass.

translations.literal: Northwest distance from prefecture one hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred fifty li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Governs counties one:
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county:

translations.literal: Ziyang, zhou east.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyang lies east of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年十二月置，屬府。

translations.literal: Hongwu year six twelfth month established, belonged to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in the twelfth month of Hongwu 6 and subordinated to the prefecture.

translations.literal: Year ten fifth month merged into Jian County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was merged into Jian County.

sentences.zh: 成化元年七月復置，仍屬府。

translations.literal: Chenghua year one seventh month restored, still belonged to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in the seventh month of Chenghua 1 and again subordinated to the prefecture.

translations.literal: Zhengde period, changed to belong to zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengde reign it was reassigned to the zhou.

translations.literal: West has Zixi River, flows into Yan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Zixi River, which flows into the Yan River.

sentences.zh: 東有資陽鎮巡檢司，後移治濛溪河。

translations.literal: East has Ziyang town patrol inspectorate, later moved seat to Mengxi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Ziyang town patrol inspectorate, later moved to the Mengxi River.

translations.literal: Chongqing zhou Yuan seat at Jinyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing zhou—under the Yuan its seat was at Jinyuan County.

translations.literal: Hongwu period merged county into zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu reign the county was merged into the zhou.

translations.literal: West has Heming Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Heming Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北有鄩江，東流入新津界。

translations.literal: Northwest has Xi River, east flows into Xinjin border.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Xi River, which flows east into Xinjin.

sentences.zh: 又北有味江，東北有白馬江，皆岷江南出之別名也。

translations.literal: Also north has Wei River, northeast has Baima River, all Min River south-out different names.
translations.idiomatic: Also to the north is the Wei River; to the northeast is the Baima River—all alternate channels of the Min River flowing south.

translations.literal: Northwest has Yongkang County.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Yongkang County.

sentences.zh: 東南有江源縣，明玉珍復置，洪武初省。

translations.literal: Southeast has Jiangyuan County, Ming Yuzhen restored, Hongwu beginning abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Jiangyuan County; Ming Yuzhen restored it, and it was abolished in early Hongwu.

translations.literal: West has Qingxikou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Qingxikou patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Northeast distance from prefecture one hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred ten li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Governs counties one:
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county:

translations.literal: Xinjin, zhou east.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjin lies east of the zhou.

translations.literal: South has Tianshe Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Tianshe Mountain.

translations.literal: East Lake in city southeast corner.
translations.idiomatic: East Lake lies in the southeast corner of the city.

sentences.zh: 西有贛江，自豐城縣流入，東北入鄱陽湖，出湖口縣，入大江，亦曰章江。

translations.literal: West has Gan River, from Fengcheng County flows in, northeast enters Poyang Lake, exits Hukou County, enters Great River, also called Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Gan River, which flows in from Fengcheng County, runs northeast into Poyang Lake, leaves at Hukou County, and enters the Great River, also called the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 又東南有武陽水，上源自南豐縣汙江，北流經此，又東北入宮亭湖。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Wuyang River, upper source from Nanfeng County Wu River, north flows through here, again northeast enters Gongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is also the Wuyang River, whose upper course rises at the Wu River in Nanfeng County; it flows north through this area and then northeast into Gongting Lake.

translations.literal: South has Shicha patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Shicha patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Xinjian, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjian was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 西有西山，跨南昌、新建、奉新、建昌四縣之境。

translations.literal: West has Xishan, spans Nanchang, Xinjian, Fengxin, Jianchang four counties' territory.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Xishan, spanning the territory of Nanchang, Xinjian, Fengxin, and Jianchang counties.

translations.literal: North has Wucheng Mountain, faces Gan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Wucheng Mountain, overlooking the Gan River.

sentences.zh: 東有鄱陽湖，即彭蠡也，俗謂之東鄱湖；

translations.literal: East has Poyang Lake, namely Pengli; commonly called Eastern Po Lake;
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Poyang Lake, that is Pengli, commonly called the Eastern Po Lake;

sentences.zh: 其西與宮亭湖相接，謂之西鄱湖西南有筠水，一名蜀江，自高安縣流入，合於章江。

translations.literal: Its west connects with Gongting Lake, called Western Po Lake; southwest has Jun River, one name Shu River, from Gao'an County flows in, joins at Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: Its west joins Gongting Lake, called the Western Po Lake; to the southwest is the Jun River, also called the Shu River, which flows in from Gao'an County and joins the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 東北有趙家圍、西有烏山、北有吳城、西北有昌邑四巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Zhaojiawei, west has Wushan, north has Wucheng, northwest has Changyi four patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Zhaojiawei, to the west Wushan, to the north Wucheng, and to the northwest Changyi—four patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Fengcheng, prefecture south slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: Fengcheng County lay south and slightly west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年十二月改爲豐城縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year twelfth month changed to Fengcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Hongwu 9 it was changed to Fengcheng County.

translations.literal: South has Luoshan, Fu River issues from here.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Luoshan, where the Fu River rises.

translations.literal: Also has Beishan, Feng River issues from here.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Beishan, where the Feng River rises.

sentences.zh: 西南有章江，豐水自南，富水自東南，俱流入焉。

translations.literal: Southwest has Zhang River, Feng River from south, Fu River from southeast, both flow in there.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Zhang River; the Feng River enters from the south and the Fu River from the southeast, both joining it.

sentences.zh: 又東有云韶水，自撫州流入，亦入於章江。

translations.literal: Also east has Yunshao River, from Fuzhou flows in, also enters Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is also the Yunshao River, which flows in from Fuzhou and likewise enters the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 南有沛源、西南有江滸口二巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Peiyuan, southwest has Jianghukou two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Peiyuan and Jianghukou patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Also has Hehu patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Hehu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又北有港口巡檢司，治大江口，後遷縣東北小江口，廢。

translations.literal: Also north has Gangkou patrol inspectorate, administered at Dajiangkou, later moved to county northeast Xiaojiangkou, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was also the Gangkou patrol inspectorate, first at Dajiangkou, later moved to Xiaojiangkou northeast of the county, and then abolished.

translations.literal: Jinxian, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Jinxian County lay southeast of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Southwest has Jinshan, produces gold.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Jinshan, which produced gold.

sentences.zh: 北有三揚水，又有軍山湖，又北有日月湖，下流俱入於鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: North has Sanyang River, also has Junshan Lake, also north has Riyue Lake, lower flows all enter Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Sanyang River; there are also Junshan Lake and, farther north, Riyue Lake, whose lower courses all flow into Poyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 東有潤陂、東北有鄔子寨、北有龍山、東南有花園四巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Runbei, northeast has Wuzizhai, north has Longshan, southeast has Huayuan four patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Runbei, to the northeast Wuzizhai, to the north Longshan, and to the southeast Huayuan—four patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Fengxin, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxin County lay west of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有百丈山，馮水所出，下流入於章江。

translations.literal: West has Baizhang Mountain, Feng River issues from here, lower flows into Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Baizhang Mountain, where the Feng River rises and flows down into the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 又西有華林山，華林水出焉。

translations.literal: Also west has Hualin Mountain, Hualin River issues from here.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Hualin Mountain, where the Hualin River rises.

sentences.zh: 又西北有藥王山，龍溪水出焉。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Yaowang Mountain, Longxi River issues from here.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Yaowang Mountain, where the Longxi River rises.

translations.literal: Two rivers join flow, pour into Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: The two rivers unite and empty into the Feng River.

translations.literal: West has Luofang patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Luofang patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Also has Baisha patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Baisha patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

translations.literal: Jing'an, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an County lay northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有毛竹山，接寧州界，雙溪水出焉，下流入於馮水。

translations.literal: West has Maozhu Mountain, adjoins Ningzhou border, Shuangxi River issues from here, lower flows into Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Maozhu Mountain on the Ningzhou border, where the Shuangxi River rises and flows down into the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 北有桃源山，桃源水所出，流與雙溪水合。

translations.literal: North has Taoyuan Mountain, Taoyuan River issues from here, flows and joins Shuangxi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Taoyuan Mountain, where the Taoyuan River rises and joins the Shuangxi River.

sentences.zh: 又西北有長溪，源出名山，下流入於修水。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Changxi, source issues from Mingshan, lower flows into Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Changxi, rising at Mingshan and flowing down into the Xiushui.

translations.literal: Wuning, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Wuning County lay northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: West has Taiping Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Taiping Mountain.

translations.literal: Northwest has Jiugong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Jiugong Mountain.

translations.literal: South has Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Xiushui.

translations.literal: Ningzhou, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Ningzhou lay west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Fenning County, was Ningzhou seat.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan Fenning County served as the seat of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，改縣爲寧縣，省州入焉。

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, changed county to Ning County, eliminated zhou and merged in.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the county was renamed Ning County and the zhou was abolished and absorbed.

translations.literal: Hongzhi sixteenth year, promoted county to zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 16 the county was promoted to a zhou.

sentences.zh: 西有幕阜山，修水發源於此，下流入鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: West has Mufu Mountain, Xiushui originates here, lower flows into Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mufu Mountain, where the Xiushui rises and flows down into Poyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 又東有鶴源水，源發九宮山，下流合修水。

translations.literal: Also east has Heyuan River, source issues from Jiugong Mountain, lower flow joins Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is also the Heyuan River, rising at Jiugong Mountain and flowing down to join the Xiushui.

sentences.zh: 西有杉市巡檢司，後遷於崇鄉北村。

translations.literal: West has Shanshi patrol inspectorate, later moved to Chongxiang North Village.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Shanshi patrol inspectorate, later moved to North Village in Chongxiang.

sentences.zh: 南有定江、又有八疊嶺二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: South has Dingjiang, also has Badie Ridge two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south were the Dingjiang and Badie Ridge patrol inspectorates, both later abolished.

translations.literal: Southeast distance from prefecture three hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred sixty li southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瑞州府元瑞州路，屬江西行省。

translations.literal: Ruizhou Prefecture Yuan Ruizhou Route, belonged to Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizhou Prefecture was under the Yuan the Ruizhou Route, subordinate to the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Hongwu second year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture.

translations.literal: Administers counties three.
translations.idiomatic: It administered three counties.

translations.literal: Northeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Gao'an, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Gao'an was the attached seat county.

translations.literal: North has Mishan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mishan.

translations.literal: Northwest has Hualin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Hualin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又北有蜀江，自上高縣流入，東流匯於南昌之象牙潭而入章江，一名錦水。

translations.literal: Also north has Shu River, from Shanggao County flows in, east flows collects at Nanchang's Xiangya Tan and enters Zhang River, one name Jin River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Shu River, which flows in from Shanggao County, runs east, gathers at Xiangya Tan in Nanchang, and enters the Zhang River, also called the Jin River.

sentences.zh: 此別一蜀江，非出岷山之大江也。

translations.literal: This is another Shu River, not the great river issuing from Min Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: This is a different Shu River, not the great Yangtze tributary that rises in the Min Mountains.

sentences.zh: 又南有曲水，亦東入章江。

translations.literal: Also south has Qu River, also east enters Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Qu River, which likewise flows east into the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 南有陰岡嶺、又有洪城二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: South has Yingang Ridge, also has Hongcheng two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south were the Yingang Ridge and Hongcheng patrol inspectorates, both later abolished.

translations.literal: Shanggao, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Shanggao County lay southwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: South has Mengshan, formerly produced silver and lead.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mengshan, which formerly produced silver and lead.

translations.literal: West has Tianling.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Tianling.

sentences.zh: 又西有蜀江，自萬載縣流入，至縣西北凌江口合新昌縣之鹽溪水。

translations.literal: Also west has Shu River, from Wanzai County flows in, to county northwest Lingjiangkou joins Xinchang County's Yanshi River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Shu River, flowing in from Wanzai County; at Lingjiangkou northwest of the county it joins the Yanshi River of Xinchang County.

sentences.zh: 又有斜口水，源出蒙山，至縣西亦流入焉。

translations.literal: Also has Xiekou River, source issues from Mengshan, to county west also flows in there.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Xiekou River, rising at Mengshan and entering the same stream west of the county.

sentences.zh: 西有離婁橋、又有麻塘二巡檢司。

translations.literal: West has Lilou Bridge, also has Matang two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are the Lilou Bridge and Matang patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Xinchang, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Xinchang County lay west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Xinchang zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Xinchang zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 西有鹽溪水，一名若耶溪，南流至上高縣入於蜀江。

translations.literal: West has Yanshi River, one name Ruoye Stream, south flows to Shanggao County enters Shu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Yanshi River, also called the Ruoye Stream, which flows south to Shanggao County and enters the Shu River.

sentences.zh: 又北有藤江，下流與鹽溪水合。

translations.literal: Also north has Teng River, lower flow joins Yanshi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is also the Teng River, whose lower course joins the Yanshi River.

sentences.zh: 西有黃岡洞、北有大姑嶺二巡檢司。

translations.literal: West has Huanggangdong, north has Daguling two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Huanggangdong and to the north Daguling—two patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 九江府元江州路，屬江西行省。

translations.literal: Jiujiang Prefecture Yuan Jiangzhou Route, belonged to Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Jiujiang Prefecture was under the Yuan the Jiangzhou Route, subordinate to the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Taizu xinchou year became Jiujiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu xinchou year it became Jiujiang Prefecture.

translations.literal: Administers counties five.
translations.idiomatic: It administered five counties.

translations.literal: South distance from Provincial Administration Commission three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred li south of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Dehua, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Dehua was the attached seat county.

translations.literal: South has Lushan, also called Kuanglu.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Lushan, also called Kuanglu.

sentences.zh: 東南有鄱陽湖，湖中有大孤山。

translations.literal: Southeast has Poyang Lake, in lake has Dagushan.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Poyang Lake, with Dagushan in the lake.

sentences.zh: 縣北濱大江，亦曰潯陽江，北岸爲湖廣黃梅縣，南岸經湖口、彭澤二縣，而入南直東流縣境。

translations.literal: County north borders Great River, also called Xunyang River, north bank is Huguang Huangmei County, south bank passes Hukou, Pengze two counties, and enters Nanzhili Dongliu County territory.
translations.idiomatic: The county bordered the Great River to the north, also called the Xunyang River; the north bank was Huangmei County in Huguang, while the south bank ran past Hukou and Pengze counties and into the territory of Dongliu County in Nanzhili.

sentences.zh: 江中有桑落州，與南直宿松縣界。

translations.literal: In river has Sangluo zhou, with Nanzhili Susong County border.
translations.idiomatic: Midstream is Sangluo zhou, on the border with Susong County in Nanzhili.

sentences.zh: 又西有湓浦，自瑞昌縣流入，經城西，注於大江，所謂湓口也。

translations.literal: Also west has Xunpu, from Ruichang County flows in, passes west of city, pours into Great River, the so-called Xunkou.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Xunpu, flowing in from Ruichang County, passing west of the city and emptying into the Great River at the place called Xunkou.

sentences.zh: 又東南有女兒浦，源出廬山，東北入鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Nü'erpu, source issues from Lushan, northeast enters Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is also Nü'erpu, rising at Lushan and flowing northeast into Poyang Lake.

translations.literal: West has Chengzi town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Chengzi town patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東有南湖觜、西有龍開河二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Nanhuzi, west has Longkaihe two patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was also Nanhuzi and to the west Longkaihe—two patrol inspectorates later abolished.

translations.literal: De'an, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: De'an County lay southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南有博陽山，古文以爲敷淺原，博陽川出焉，東南流入於鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: South has Boyang Mountain, ancient text regarded as Fushallow Plain, Boyang River issues from here, southeast flows into Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Boyang Mountain, identified in ancient texts as Fushallow Plain; the Boyang River rises there and flows southeast into Poyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 東北有谷簾水，源出廬山，下流亦入鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: Northeast has Guliang River, source issues from Lushan, lower flow also enters Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Guliang River, rising at Lushan and likewise flowing down into Poyang Lake.

translations.literal: Ruichang, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Ruichang County lay west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: West has Qingchuan Mountain, Xun River issues from here.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Qingchuan Mountain, where the Xun River rises.

sentences.zh: 北有大江，北岸與湖廣廣濟縣分界。

translations.literal: North has Great River, north bank with Huguang Guangji County divides border.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Great River, whose north bank formed the boundary with Guangji County in Huguang.

translations.literal: Hukou, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Hukou County lay east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: North borders Great River.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered the Great River to the north.

translations.literal: South has Upper Shizhong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Upper Shizhong Mountain.

translations.literal: North has Lower Shizhong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Lower Shizhong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又南有青山，在鄱陽湖中。

translations.literal: Also south has Qingshan, in Poyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also Qingshan, in Poyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 西南即鄱陽湖，匯章、貢羣川之水，由此入江。

translations.literal: Southwest is Poyang Lake, collects Zhang, Gong group rivers' waters, from here enters river.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Poyang Lake, which gathers the waters of the Zhang, Gong, and related rivers and from here discharges into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 南有湖口鎮巡檢司，後遷上石鐘山。

translations.literal: South has Hukou town patrol inspectorate, later moved to Upper Shizhong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Hukou town patrol inspectorate, later moved to Upper Shizhong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北有茭石磯鎮巡檢司，後遷於黃茅潭。

translations.literal: Northwest has Jiaoshi ji town patrol inspectorate, later moved to Huangmao Tan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Jiaoshi ji town patrol inspectorate, later moved to Huangmao Tan.

translations.literal: Pengze, prefecture east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Pengze County lay east and slightly north of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Borders Great River.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered the Great River.

sentences.zh: 北有小孤山在江中，江濱有彭浪磯，與小孤對。

translations.literal: North has Xiaogushan in river, river bank has Penglang ji, facing Xiaogu.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Xiaogushan in midstream, with Penglang ji on the riverbank opposite it.

sentences.zh: 東北有馬當山，橫枕大江。

translations.literal: Northeast has Madang Mountain, lies across Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Madang Mountain, spanning the Great River.

translations.literal: Has Madang Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There was the Madang Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 西南有峯山、磯鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Fengshan, Jizhen two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest were the Fengshan and Jizhen patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 南唐府元南唐路，屬江西行省。

translations.literal: Nankang Prefecture Yuan Nankang Route, belonged to Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang Prefecture was Nankang Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖辛丑年八月爲西寧府。

translations.literal: Founding Emperor xinchou year eighth month became Xining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the xinchou year of the founding emperor it became Xining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅年四月改曰南康府。

translations.literal: Renyin year fourth month changed name to Nankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the renyin year it was renamed Nankang Prefecture.

translations.literal: Administers counties four.
translations.idiomatic: It administered four counties.

translations.literal: South distance from Provincial Administration Commission three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred li south of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Xingzi, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzi was the attached seat county.

translations.literal: Northwest has Mt. Lu.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Lu.

translations.literal: North has Mt. Xie, in Lake Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Xie, in Lake Poyang.

sentences.zh: 湖東爲宮亭湖，西北爲落星湖。

translations.literal: Lake east is Gongting Lake, northwest is Luoxing Lake.
translations.idiomatic: East of the lake is Gongting Lake; to the northwest is Luoxing Lake.

sentences.zh: 又西有谷簾水，下流入鄱陽湖。

translations.literal: Also west has Gullian Stream, lower flows into Lake Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Gullian Stream, whose lower course flows into Lake Poyang.

sentences.zh: 東有長嶺巡檢司，後遷縣南渚溪鎮，又遷縣東北青山鎮，仍故名。

translations.literal: East has Changling Patrol Inspectorate, later moved to county south Zhuxi Town, again moved to county northeast Qingshan Town, still former name.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Changling Patrol Inspectorate; it was later moved to Zhuxi Town south of the county, then again to Qingshan Town northeast of the county, while retaining its former name.

translations.literal: Duchang, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Duchang County lies east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有石壁山，臨章江，東南爲鄱陽湖，北有後港河，合諸水入焉。

translations.literal: Southwest has Mt. Shibi, overlooks Zhang River, southeast is Lake Poyang, north has Hougang River, all waters unite and enter.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Shibi, overlooking the Zhang River; to the southeast is Lake Poyang; to the north is the Hougang River, where various waters unite and enter it.

sentences.zh: 西北有左蠡巡檢司，濱湖。

translations.literal: Northwest has Zuoli Patrol Inspectorate, on lake shore.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Zuoli Patrol Inspectorate, on the lakeshore.

sentences.zh: 東南有柴棚巡檢司，在湖中。

translations.literal: Southeast has Chaipeng Patrol Inspectorate, in lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Chaipeng Patrol Inspectorate, in the lake.

translations.literal: Jianchang, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang County lies southwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Jianchang zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Jianchang zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 西南有長山，南有修水，自寧州流入，亦謂之西河。

translations.literal: Southwest has Mt. Chang, south has Xiushui River, from Ningzhou flows in, also called West River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Chang; to the south is the Xiushui River, which flows in from Ningzhou and is also called the West River.

translations.literal: East has Lutang Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Lutang Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Anyi, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Anyi County lies southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正德十三年二月析建昌縣安義等五鄉置。

translations.literal: Zhengde thirteenth year second month partitioned from Jianchang County Anyi and four other townships established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Zhengde 13 it was established by partitioning off Anyi and four other townships from Jianchang County.

sentences.zh: 東有東陽新逕水，南有龍江水，俱流合於修水。

translations.literal: East has Dongyang Xinjing Stream, south has Longjiang River, both flow join Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Dongyang Xinjing Stream; to the south is the Longjiang River; both flow to join the Xiushui.

sentences.zh: 饒州府元饒州路，屬江浙行省。

translations.literal: Raozhou Prefecture Yuan Raozhou Route, belonged to Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Raozhou Prefecture was Raozhou Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖辛丑年八月爲鄱陽府，隸江南行省。

translations.literal: Founding Emperor xinchou year eighth month became Poyang Prefecture, subordinate to Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the xinchou year of the founding emperor it became Poyang Prefecture, subordinate to the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Shortly called Raozhou Prefecture, came subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter it was called Raozhou Prefecture and was placed under this administration.

translations.literal: Administers counties seven.
translations.idiomatic: It administered seven counties.

sentences.zh: 西南距布政司二百四十里。

translations.literal: Southwest distance from Provincial Administration Commission two hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred forty li southwest of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Poyang, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Poyang was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，淮王府自廣東韶州府遷此。

translations.literal: Zhengtong first year, Huai Princely Establishment from Guangdong Shaozhou Prefecture moved here.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong the Huai Princely Establishment was moved here from Shaozhou Prefecture in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 西北有鄱陽山，在鄱陽湖中。

translations.literal: Northwest has Mt. Poyang, in Lake Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Poyang, in Lake Poyang.

sentences.zh: 湖長三百里，闊四十里，亙南康、饒州、南昌、九江四府之境。

translations.literal: Lake long three hundred li, wide forty li, spans Nankang, Raozhou, Nanchang, Jiujiang four prefectures' territories.
translations.idiomatic: The lake is three hundred li long and forty li wide, extending across the territories of the four prefectures of Nankang, Raozhou, Nanchang, and Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 南有鄱江，源出南直婺源縣及祁門縣，下流會於城東。

translations.literal: South has Pojiang, source from Nanzhili Wuyuan County and Qimen County, lower flow meets east of city.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Pojiang, whose sources are in Wuyuan and Qimen counties of Nanzhili; its lower course meets east of the city.

sentences.zh: 又南則廣信上饒江來合焉，環城西北出，復分爲二，俱入鄱陽湖，亦名雙港水。

translations.literal: Also south then Guangxin Shangrao River comes to join, circles city northwest exits, again divides into two, both enter Lake Poyang, also named Shuanggang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south the Shangrao River from Guangxin comes to join it; winding northwest around the city it then divides in two, both entering Lake Poyang, also called the Shuanggang River.

sentences.zh: 又東有東湖，一名督軍湖，流入鄱江。

translations.literal: Also east has East Lake, one name Supervisor's Army Lake, flows into Pojiang.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is East Lake, also called the Supervisor's Army Lake, which flows into the Pojiang.

sentences.zh: 西北有棠陰巡檢司，遷於雙港口。

translations.literal: Northwest has Tangyin Patrol Inspectorate, moved to Shuanggang Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Tangyin Patrol Inspectorate, moved to Shuanggang Mouth.

translations.literal: North has Shimen Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Shimen Town Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Also northeast has Dayang Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is Dayang Ford.

translations.literal: West has Bazinao.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Bazinao.

translations.literal: Yugan, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Yugan County lies south of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Raogan zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Raogan zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 西北有康郎山，濱鄱陽湖南涯，因名其水曰康朗湖。

translations.literal: Northwest has Mt. Kanglang, on Lake Poyang south shore, therefore named its water Kanglang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Kanglang, on the southern shore of Lake Poyang; the water there is accordingly named Kanglang Lake.

translations.literal: Also west has Zuting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Zuting Lake.

sentences.zh: 又南有餘水，亦曰三餘水。

translations.literal: Also south has Yushui, also called Three-Yu River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Yushui, also called the Three-Yu River.

sentences.zh: 又南有龍窟河，合於餘水，下入鄱江。

translations.literal: Also south has Longku River, joins Yushui, below enters Pojiang.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Longku River, which joins the Yushui and below flows into the Pojiang.

sentences.zh: 有康山巡檢司，舊在康郎山上，後遷黃埠。

translations.literal: Has Kangshan Patrol Inspectorate, formerly on Mt. Kanglang, later moved to Huangbu.
translations.idiomatic: There was the Kangshan Patrol Inspectorate, formerly on Mt. Kanglang; it was later moved to Huangbu.

sentences.zh: 西有瑞虹鎮，在鄱陽湖濱。

translations.literal: West has Ruihong Town, on Lake Poyang shore.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Ruihong Town, on the shore of Lake Poyang.

translations.literal: Leping, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Leping County lies east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Leping zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Leping zhou.

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was demoted to a county.

translations.literal: Northeast has Mt. Fengyou.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Mt. Fengyou.

sentences.zh: 南有樂安江，即鄱江之上流也。

translations.literal: South has Le'an River, namely Pojiang upper course.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Le'an River, which is the upper course of the Pojiang.

translations.literal: North has Bajian Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Bajian Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 南有仙鶴鎮巡檢司，後遷萬年縣之苛溪鎮。

translations.literal: South has Xianhe Town Patrol Inspectorate, later moved to Wannian County Kexi Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Xianhe Town Patrol Inspectorate; it was later moved to Kexi Town in Wannian County.

translations.literal: Fuliang, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Fuliang County lies east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元浮樑州，洪武初降爲縣。

translations.literal: Yuan Fuliang zhou, Hongwu beginning demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Fuliang zhou; at the beginning of Hongwu it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 南有昌江，南直祁門縣之水俱流匯焉，鄱江之別源也。

translations.literal: South has Chang River, Nanzhili Qimen County waters all flow converge, Pojiang separate source.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Chang River, where the waters from Qimen County of Nanzhili all converge; it is a separate source of the Pojiang.

sentences.zh: 西北有桃樹鎮巡檢司，後遷縣東北勒上市。

translations.literal: Northwest has Taoshu Town Patrol Inspectorate, later moved to county northeast Leshangshi.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Taoshu Town Patrol Inspectorate; it was later moved to Leshangshi northeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 西南有景德鎮，宣德初，置御器廠於此。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jingde Town, Xuande beginning, established imperial porcelain factory here.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Jingde Town; at the beginning of Xuande the imperial porcelain factory was established here.

translations.literal: Dexing, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing County lies east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: East has Mt. Yin, formerly produced silver.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Yin, which formerly produced silver.

sentences.zh: 北有銅山，山麓有膽泉，浸鐵可以成銅。

translations.literal: North has Mt. Tong, mountain foot has Gall Spring, soaking iron can form copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Tong; at its foot is the Gall Spring, by soaking iron in which copper can be formed.

sentences.zh: 西南有建節水，自弋陽縣流入。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jianjie River, from Yiyang County flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Jianjie River, which flows in from Yiyang County.

sentences.zh: 北有大溪，自南直婺源縣流入。

translations.literal: North has Daxi, from Nanzhili Wuyuan County flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Daxi, which flows in from Wuyuan County of Nanzhili.

translations.literal: Lower flows all join Le'an River.
translations.idiomatic: Their lower courses all join the Le'an River.

translations.literal: East has Baisha Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Baisha Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Southwest has Yongtai Patrol Inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was the Yongtai Patrol Inspectorate, which was abolished.

translations.literal: Anren, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Anren County lies south and slightly east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南有錦江，亦名安仁港，自貴溪縣流入，西北入餘干境，爲龍窟河。

translations.literal: South has Jin River, also named Anren Harbor, from Guixi County flows in, northwest enters Yugan territory, becomes Longku River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Jin River, also called Anren Harbor; it flows in from Guixi County, enters Yugan territory to the northwest, and becomes the Longku River.

sentences.zh: 又東有白塔河，流合於錦江。

translations.literal: Also east has Baita River, flows join Jin River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Baita River, which flows to join the Jin River.

sentences.zh: 南有白塔、東有田南二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: South has Baita, east has Tiannan two patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Baita and to the east the Tiannan patrol inspectorates; both were later abolished.

translations.literal: Wannian, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Wannian County lies southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正德七年以餘干縣之萬春鄉置，析鄱陽、 樂平及貴溪三縣地益之。

translations.literal: Zhengde seventh year from Yugan County Wanchun Township established, partitioned Poyang, Leping and Guixi three counties land added.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 7 it was established from Wanchun Township of Yugan County, with territory partitioned from Poyang, Leping, and Guixi counties added.

translations.literal: North has Mt. Wannian.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Wannian.

sentences.zh: 東有桃源洞，桃源水出焉，經縣西南，下流爲餘水。

translations.literal: East has Taoyuan Cave, Taoyuan Stream issues, passes county southwest, lower flow is Yushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Taoyuan Cave, whence the Taoyuan Stream issues; passing southwest of the county, its lower course is the Yushui.

sentences.zh: 東北有荷溪鎮、北有石頭街二巡檢司，後俱廢。

translations.literal: Northeast has Hexi Town, north has Shitou Street two patrol inspectorates, later both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was Hexi Town and to the north Shitou Street patrol inspectorates; both were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣信府元信州路，屬江浙行省。

translations.literal: Guangxin Prefecture Yuan Xinzhou Route, belonged to Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxin Prefecture was Xinzhou Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖庚子年五月爲廣信府。

translations.literal: Founding Emperor gengzi year fifth month became Guangxin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the gengzi year of the founding emperor it became Guangxin Prefecture.

translations.literal: Administers counties seven.
translations.idiomatic: It administered seven counties.

sentences.zh: 西北距布政司六百三十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from Provincial Administration Commission six hundred thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay six hundred thirty li northwest of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Shangrao, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Shangrao was the attached seat county.

translations.literal: Northwest has Mt. Ling, formerly produced crystal.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Ling, which formerly produced crystal.

translations.literal: South has Mt. Dingxi, produces iron.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Dingxi, which produces iron.

translations.literal: Also south has Mt. Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Mt. Tong.

sentences.zh: 北有上饒江，自玉山縣流入，經城北，下流至鄱陽縣合於鄱江。

translations.literal: North has Shangrao River, from Yushan County flows in, passes north of city, lower flow to Poyang County joins Pojiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Shangrao River, which flows in from Yushan County, passes north of the city, and below flows to Poyang County where it joins the Pojiang.

sentences.zh: 又西有櫧溪，源出靈山，亦曰靈溪，流入上饒江。

translations.literal: Also west has Zhuxi, source from Mt. Ling, also called Ling Stream, flows into Shangrao River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Zhuxi, which rises on Mt. Ling, is also called the Ling Stream, and flows into the Shangrao River.

sentences.zh: 南有八坊場、東北有鄭家坊二巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Bafangchang, northeast has Zhengjiafang two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Bafangchang and to the northeast the Zhengjiafang patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Yushan, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Yushan County lies east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Has Mt. Sanqing.
translations.idiomatic: There is Mt. Sanqing.

sentences.zh: 又有懷玉山，玉溪出焉，分二流，東入浙，西爲上饒江。

translations.literal: Also has Mt. Huaiyu, Yuxi issues, divides two streams, east enters Zhejiang, west becomes Shangrao River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Mt. Huaiyu, whence the Yuxi issues and divides into two streams: east into Zhejiang, west forming the Shangrao River.

translations.literal: Southeast has Liuduzhai Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Liuduzhai Patrol Inspectorate.

translations.literal: Yiyang, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyang County lies west of the prefecture.

translations.literal: South has Mt. Junyang, formerly produced silver.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Junyang, which formerly produced silver.

sentences.zh: 東有弋陽江，即上饒江下流也，又有弋溪流合焉。

translations.literal: East has Yiyang River, namely Shangrao River lower course, also has Yixi flows join.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Yiyang River, the lower course of the Shangrao River; the Yixi also flows to join it.

sentences.zh: 又有葛溪，源出上饒縣靈山，下流入鄱江。

translations.literal: Also has Gexi, source from Shangrao County Mt. Ling, lower flows into Pojiang.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Gexi, rising on Mt. Ling in Shangrao County, whose lower course flows into the Pojiang.

sentences.zh: 又有信義港，自福建邵武流入，合於葛溪。

translations.literal: Also has Xinyi Harbor, from Fujian Shaowu flows in, joins Gexi.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Xinyi Harbor, which flows in from Shaowu in Fujian and joins the Gexi.

translations.literal: Guixi, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Guixi County lies west of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有象山，又有龍虎山，上清宮在焉。

translations.literal: Southwest has Elephant Mountain, also has Dragon-and-Tiger Mountain, Shangqing Abbey is there.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Elephant Mountain and Dragon-and-Tiger Mountain, where Shangqing Abbey stands.

translations.literal: Its south is Immortal Cliff.
translations.idiomatic: To its south is Immortal Cliff.

sentences.zh: 又南有薌溪，亦名貴溪，上流即上饒江也。

translations.literal: Further south has Xiang Creek, also named Guixi Creek, upper reaches are Shangrao River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Xiang Creek, also called Guixi Creek, whose upper course is the Shangrao River.

sentences.zh: 又有須溪，自福建光澤縣流入，來合焉。

translations.literal: Also has Xu Creek, from Fujian Guangze County flows in, comes to join.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Xu Creek, which flows in from Guangze County in Fujian and joins it.

translations.literal: South has Guanjie Stockade patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Guanjie Stockade patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 西有神前街巡檢司，本神峯寨，在縣北，後遷潭溪，更名。

translations.literal: West has Shenqian Street patrol inspectorate, originally Shenfeng Stockade, in county north, later moved to Tan Creek, renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Shenqian Street patrol inspectorate, originally Shenfeng Stockade in the north of the county; it was later moved to Tan Creek and renamed.

translations.literal: Qianshan, south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qianshan lies south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元鉛山州，直隸江浙行省，治在八樹嶺之南。

translations.literal: Yuan Qianshan zhou, directly subordinate Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, seat south of Eight-Tree Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Qianshan Zhou, directly subordinate to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, with its seat south of Eight-Tree Ridge.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，降爲縣，遷於今治。

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, reduced to county, moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was reduced to a county and moved to the present seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有銅寶山，涌泉浸鐵可以爲銅。

translations.literal: Southwest has Tongbao Mountain, gushing springs soak iron and can make copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Tongbao Mountain, where gushing springs soak iron so that it can be worked into copper.

sentences.zh: 又有鉛山，產鉛銅及青綠。

translations.literal: Also has Qianshan, produces lead, copper, and malachite green.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Qianshan, which yields lead, copper, and malachite green.

translations.literal: North has Ehu Lake Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Ehu Lake Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南有分水嶺，與福建崇安縣界，上有分水關巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Fen River Ridge, borders Fujian Chong'an County, above has Fen River Pass patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Fen River Ridge, on the border with Chong'an County in Fujian; on it is the Fen River Pass patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又有紫溪嶺，紫溪水出焉。

translations.literal: Also has Zixi Ridge, Zixi Creek issues therefrom.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Zixi Ridge, from which Zixi Creek rises.

sentences.zh: 北有上饒江，至汭口，與紫溪、桐木、黃櫱諸水合流，入弋陽縣界，謂之鉛山河口。

translations.literal: North has Shangrao River, reaches Ruikou, with Zixi, Tongmu, Huangbo and other waters joins flow, enters Yiyang County border, called Qianshan River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Shangrao River, which at Ruikou joins Zixi, Tongmu, Huangbo, and other streams and enters Yiyang County, where it is called the Qianshan River mouth.

sentences.zh: 又東北有石溪，亦流合上饒江。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Stone Creek, also flows to join Shangrao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Stone Creek, which likewise flows into the Shangrao River.

sentences.zh: 西南有石佛寨巡檢司，後遷善政鄉湖坊街。

translations.literal: Southwest has Stone Buddha Stockade patrol inspectorate, later moved to Hufang Street in Shanzheng Township.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Stone Buddha Stockade patrol inspectorate, later moved to Hufang Street in Shanzheng Township.

sentences.zh: 又西有駐泊巡檢司，治汭口鎮，廢。

translations.literal: Also west has Anchorage patrol inspectorate, seat at Ruikou town, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Anchorage patrol inspectorate, seated at Ruikou town; it was abolished.

translations.literal: Yongfeng, south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yongfeng lies south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東南有平洋山，舊產銀礦。

translations.literal: Southeast has Pingyang Mountain, formerly produced silver ore.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Pingyang Mountain, which formerly yielded silver ore.

sentences.zh: 南有永豐溪，源出福建浦城縣界，下流至上饒縣界合玉溪。

translations.literal: South has Yongfeng Creek, source at Fujian Pucheng County border, lower flow to Shangrao County border joins Yuxi Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Yongfeng Creek, rising on the border of Pucheng County in Fujian; its lower course reaches the Shangrao County border and joins Yuxi Creek.

sentences.zh: 又東有永平溪，西會杉溪及諸溪谷之水，注於永豐溪。

translations.literal: Also east has Yongping Creek, west meets Shanxi Creek and valley streams' waters, pours into Yongfeng Creek.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Yongping Creek, which on the west receives Shanxi Creek and other valley streams and empties into Yongfeng Creek.

translations.literal: East has Zheyang Stockade patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Zheyang Stockade patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Also has Shanxi Stockade patrol inspectorate, abolished.
