translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Ningdu zhou; at the beginning of Hongwu it was reduced to a county.

translations.literal: Northwest has Jinjing Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Jinjing Mountain.

translations.literal: North has Mei Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mei Ridge.

sentences.zh: 南有寧都水，與散水、篔簹、曲陽、黃沙、長樂五水合，又東北有虔化水，下流俱入於雩水。

translations.literal: South has Ningdu Water, with Sanshui, Yundang, Quyang, Huangsha, Changle five waters combine, also northeast has Qianhua Water, lower flows all enter at Yu Water.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Ningdu Water, which joins Sanshui, Yundang, Quyang, Huangsha, and Changle waters; to the northeast is Qianhua Water; all their lower courses enter Yu Water.

sentences.zh: 又有梅川水，出梅嶺，下流亦經雩都縣入貢水。

translations.literal: Also has Meichuan Water, issues from Mei Ridge, lower flow also passes through Yudu County enters Gong Water.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Meichuan Water, which rises on Mei Ridge and below passes through Yudu County into the Gong River.

translations.literal: Southeast has Xiahe Stockade patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Xiahe Stockade patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Ruijin, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Ruijin lies east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元屬會昌州，洪武初改屬府。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Huichang zhou, Hongwu beginning changed subordination to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Huichang zhou; at the beginning of Hongwu it was reassigned to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東北有陳石山，綿江出焉，流至縣南入貢水，又西入會昌縣，爲湘洪水。

translations.literal: Northeast has Chenshi Mountain, Mian River issues therefrom, flows to county south enters Gong Water, also west enters Huichang County, becomes Xianghong Water.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Chenshi Mountain, whence Mian River rises; it flows south of the county into the Gong River, then west into Huichang County as Xianghong Water.

sentences.zh: 西北有瑞林、東北有湖陂二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Ruilin, northeast has Hupo two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Ruilin patrol inspectorate and to the northeast the Hupo patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 東南有古城鎮，路出福建長汀縣。

translations.literal: Southeast has Gucheng Town, road exits toward Fujian Changting County.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Gucheng Town, on the road out to Changting County in Fujian.

translations.literal: Longnan, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Longnan lies south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元屬寧都州，洪武初改屬府。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Ningdu zhou, Hongwu beginning changed subordination to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Ningdu zhou; at the beginning of Hongwu it was reassigned to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有冬桃山，桃水出焉，東北流會諸水，至縣北宮山下，與渥、濂二水合爲三江口，又北流爲信豐縣之桃江。

translations.literal: Southwest has Dongtao Mountain, Tao Water issues therefrom, flows northeast joins various waters, reaches county north below Gongsan, with Wo, Lian two waters combine becomes Sanjiang Mouth, again north flow becomes Xinfeng County's Tao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Dongtao Mountain, whence Tao Water rises; flowing northeast it joins other streams, and north of the county below Gongsan it unites with the Wo and Lian rivers at Sanjiang Mouth; flowing north again it becomes the Tao River of Xinfeng County.

sentences.zh: 有冬桃隘，崇禎初，移定南縣下歷巡檢司駐焉。

translations.literal: Has Dongtao Pass, Chongzhen beginning, moved Dingnan County Xiali patrol inspectorate stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: There is Dongtao Pass; at the beginning of Chongzhen the Xiali patrol inspectorate of Dingnan County was moved to be stationed there.

translations.literal: Shicheng, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng lies northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元元貞元年十一月屬寧都州，洪武初改屬府。

translations.literal: Yuan Yuanzhen first year eleventh month belonged to Ningdu zhou, Hongwu beginning changed subordination to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Yuanzhen 1 of the Yuan it belonged to Ningdu zhou; at the beginning of Hongwu it was reassigned to the prefecture.

translations.literal: North has Yashu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Yashu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有霸水，西南合虔化水，入貢江。

translations.literal: East has Ba Water, southwest joins Qianhua Water, enters Gong River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Ba Water, which flowing southwest joins Qianhua Water and enters the Gong River.

sentences.zh: 北有捉殺寨巡檢司，後遷縣西赤江市，仍故名。

translations.literal: North has Zhuosha Stockade patrol inspectorate, later moved to county west Chijiang City, still original name.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was the Zhuosha Stockade patrol inspectorate, later moved to Chijiang City west of the county, retaining its original name.

translations.literal: Dingnan, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Dingnan lies southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年三月以龍南縣之蓮莆鎮置。

translations.literal: Longqing third year third month from Longnan County's Lianpu Town established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Longqing 3 it was established from Lianpu Town in Longnan County.

sentences.zh: 析安遠、信豐二縣地益之。

translations.literal: Divided Anyuan, Xinfeng two counties' territory to augment it.
translations.idiomatic: Territory was taken from Anyuan and Xinfeng counties to enlarge it.

sentences.zh: 西北有程嶺，又南有神仙嶺。

translations.literal: Northwest has Cheng Ridge, also south has Shenxian Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Cheng Ridge and to the south Shenxian Ridge.

translations.literal: East has Zhihui Peak.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Zhihui Peak.

sentences.zh: 東北有九洲河，下流會於信豐縣之桃江。

translations.literal: Northeast has Jiuzhou River, lower flow joins at Xinfeng County's Tao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Jiuzhou River, whose lower course joins the Tao River in Xinfeng County.

sentences.zh: 東北有下歷巡檢司，後遷高砂蓮塘，又遷龍南縣冬桃隘。

translations.literal: Northeast has Xiali patrol inspectorate, later moved to Gaosha Liantang, again moved to Longnan County Dongtao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was the Xiali patrol inspectorate, later moved to Gaosha Liantang and then to Dongtao Pass in Longnan County.

translations.literal: Changning, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Changning lies southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四年三月以安遠縣之馬蹄岡置，析會昌縣地益之。

translations.literal: Wanli fourth year third month from Anyuan County's Mati'gang established, divided Huichang County territory to augment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Wanli 4 it was established from Mati'gang in Anyuan County, with territory taken from Huichang County to enlarge it.

sentences.zh: 東南有頂山，又南有大帽山，俱接閩、廣境。

translations.literal: Southeast has Ding Mountain, also south has Damao Mountain, all connect Min, Guang borders.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Ding Mountain and to the south Damao Mountain, both on the borders of Fujian and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 又東有尋鄔水，流入廣東龍川縣界。

translations.literal: Also east has Xunwu Water, flows into Guangdong Longchuan County border.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is Xunwu Water, which flows into the border of Longchuan County in Guangdong.

translations.literal: Northwest has Huangxiang patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Huangxiang patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 南有新坪巡檢司，本大墩，後更名。

translations.literal: South has Xinping patrol inspectorate, originally Dadun, later renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Xinping patrol inspectorate, originally Dadun, later renamed.

sentences.zh: 北有雙橋、南有丹竹樓二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: North has Shuangqiao, south has Danzhulou two patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was the Shuangqiao patrol inspectorate and to the south the Danzhulou patrol inspectorate; both were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 南安府元南安路，屬江西行省。

translations.literal: Nan'an Prefecture Yuan Nan'an Route, belonged to Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Nan'an Prefecture was under the Yuan the Nan'an Route, subordinate to the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Taizu yisi year made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Founder's yisi year it was made a prefecture.

translations.literal: Administers counties four.
translations.idiomatic: It administered four counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司一千五百二十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission one thousand five hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand five hundred twenty li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: Dayu, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Dayu was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 西南有大庾嶺，五嶺之一，亦名梅嶺，上有關曰梅關。

translations.literal: Southwest has Dayu Ridge, one of Five Ridges, also named Mei Ridge, on it has pass called Mei Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Dayu Ridge, one of the Five Ridges, also called Mei Ridge, on which is the pass known as Mei Pass.

sentences.zh: 又有章江，亦曰南江，亦曰橫江，下流與貢水合。

translations.literal: Also has Zhang River, also called South River, also called Heng River, lower flow with Gong Water joins.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Zhang River, also called the South River or Heng River, whose lower course joins the Gong River.

sentences.zh: 西有鬱林鎮巡檢司，治晶都村，後遷浮江隘，又遷黃泥港，東北有赤石嶺巡檢司，治峯山裏，後遷小溪城，又遷峯山新城，後遷峯山水西村，俱仍故名。

translations.literal: West has Yulin Town patrol inspectorate, administered Jingdu Village, later moved to Fujiang Pass, again moved to Huangni Harbor, northeast has Chishiling patrol inspectorate, administered Fengshan li, later moved to Xiaoxi City, again moved to Fengshan New City, later moved to Fengshan Water West Village, all still original names.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Yulin Town patrol inspectorate, first at Jingdu Village, later moved to Fujiang Pass and then to Huangni Harbor; to the northeast was the Chishiling patrol inspectorate, first at Fengshan li, later moved to Xiaoxi City, then to Fengshan New City, and finally to Fengshan Water West Village; all retained their original names.

sentences.zh: 又縣南有水南城，與府城隔江對峙，嘉靖四十年築。

translations.literal: Also county south has Shuicheng City, with prefecture city across river facing, Jiajing fortieth year built.
translations.idiomatic: South of the county is Shuicheng City, facing the prefectural city across the river; it was built in Jiajing 40.

translations.literal: Northwest has Xintian City.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Xintian City.

sentences.zh: 又北有鳳凰城，又西有楊梅城，俱嘉靖四十四年築。

translations.literal: Also north has Fenghuang City, also west has Yangmei City, all Jiajing forty-fourth year built.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is Fenghuang City and to the west Yangmei City; both were built in Jiajing 44.

translations.literal: Also east has Jiusuo City.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Jiusuo City.

translations.literal: Also Jiajing forty-fourth year built.
translations.idiomatic: It too was built in Jiajing 44.

translations.literal: Nankang, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang lies northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西北有禽山，禽水出焉，東流至南野口入於章江。

translations.literal: Northwest has Qin Mountain, Qin Water issues therefrom, flows east to Nanye Mouth enters at Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Qin Mountain, whence Qin Water rises; it flows east to Nanye Mouth and enters the Zhang River.

translations.literal: North has Yangling Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Yangling Mountain.

translations.literal: South has Furong River, namely Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Furong River, which is the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 東北有潭口鎮、北有相安鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Tankou Town, north has Xiang'an Town two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Tankou Town patrol inspectorate and to the north the Xiang'an Town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Shangyou, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyou lies northeast of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Yuan Yongqing County, Hongwu beginning renamed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Yongqing County; at the beginning of Hongwu it was renamed.

translations.literal: West has Shu Mountain, one name Grand Tutor Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Shu Mountain, also called Grand Tutor Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有大猶山，猶水出焉，下流至南康縣，入於章江。

translations.literal: East has Great You Mountain, You Water issues therefrom, lower flow reaches Nankang County, enters Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Great You Mountain, whence You Water rises; its lower course reaches Nankang County and enters the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 西有浮龍巡檢司，後遷太傅村，仍故名。

translations.literal: West has Floating Dragon patrol inspectorate, later moved to Taifu Village, still former name.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Floating Dragon patrol inspectorate, later moved to Taifu Village, while retaining its former name.

translations.literal: Chongyi, prefecture north.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi lies north of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正德十四年三月以上猶縣之崇義裏置，析大庾、南康二縣地益之。

translations.literal: Zhengde fourteenth year third month established from Shangyou County's Chongyi li, divided Dayu, Nankang two counties' territory to augment it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhengde 14 it was established from Chongyi li in Shangyou County, with territory taken from Dayu and Nankang counties to enlarge it.

translations.literal: Southwest has Niedu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Niedu Mountain.

translations.literal: West has Tonggang.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Tonggang.

sentences.zh: 又有章江，自湖廣宜章縣流入，又有橫水，經縣南，又西南有左溪，下流俱合章江。

translations.literal: Also has Zhang River, from Huguang Yizhang County flows in, also has Heng Water, passes county south, also southwest has Zuo Creek, lower flows all join Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Zhang River, which flows in from Yizhang County in Huguang; there is also Heng Water, which passes south of the county; and to the southwest is Zuo Creek—all of whose lower courses join the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 西北有上保巡檢司，本過步，後遷治，更名。

translations.literal: Northwest has Shangbao patrol inspectorate, originally Guobu, later moved seat, renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Shangbao patrol inspectorate, originally at Guobu; it was later moved and renamed.

sentences.zh: 西南有鉛廠巡檢司，本在鉛山，後遷聶都，東南有長龍巡檢司，本治降平裏，後遷縣東北尚德里江頭，俱仍故名。

translations.literal: Southwest has Lead Works patrol inspectorate, originally at Yanshan, later moved to Niedu, southeast has Changlong patrol inspectorate, originally administered at Jiangping li, later moved to Jiangtou in Shangde li northeast of county, all still former names.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Lead Works patrol inspectorate, originally at Yanshan and later moved to Niedu; to the southeast is the Changlong patrol inspectorate, originally at Jiangping li and later moved to Jiangtou in Shangde li northeast of the county—all while retaining their former names.
